mapper.insert: insert into order_event_outbox (event_id, event_type, aggregate_id, user_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, locked_until, lock_token, last_error, processed_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateId}, #{userId}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{lockedUntil}, #{lockToken}, #{lastError}, #{processedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update order_event_outbox set status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = #{now}, locked_until = null, lock_token = null, last_error = null, processed_at = null, update_time = #{now} where id = #{id} and status = 'DEAD'
mapper.select: select sum(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) as pending, sum(case when status = 'PROCESSING' then 1 else 0 end) as processing, sum(case when status = 'PROCESSED' then 1 else 0 end) as processed, sum(case when status = 'DEAD' then 1 else 0 end) as dead from order_event_outbox
select count(*) from order_event_outbox where status = 'DEAD'
